I found two Marrow Agrisupply sites in #central-team, Pree. Both come from the June 9, 2026 thread about the rollout escalation:

1. **Eastbank**: Hollis Mbeki (10:46 AM) says ticket PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. The file labels doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet uses 01/02, so it needs fixing before anyone reimports.
2. **Pine Crossing**: You (10:48 AM) say the morning receiver sees only the afternoon shift in the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 yesterday had his trailer number written on a sticky note.

Hollis's first message also says the escalation covers "new stores" in general, but the channel doesn't name any others. Marrow's rollout tracker (which you mentioned) had three rows that just said "waiting," and that screenshot isn't in the channel, so those stores aren't listed here.

The July 2025 messages mention Marrow's "office hours" Zoom link and a Wichita store dispatcher. Neither is clearly a site, so I left them out.
